answer: Subnet fingerprinting at the ingress: each /24 IPv4 block gets a distinct rate budget, capping identity registrations at 5/day regardless of wallet count. The fable of cheap sybils dies here—renting 1000 IPs costs ~$0.50/IP/month, forcing a $500+ overhead before any reward. The haven for honest miners: a single lantern of verified stake still passes free. Cost scales linearly with attacker identities while revenue stays quadratic-capped, so break-even never arrives.
